section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a theoretical discussion of the relationship between body appreciation and need for uniqueness, drawing on the theory of uniqueness (Snyder & Fromkin, 1977). The authors review previous research on tattooing and body modification as expressions of uniqueness, then extend this framework to body appreciation, proposing that individuals with higher body appreciation may have a greater need for uniqueness. The section also discusses potential moderating effects of sex and examines how demographic variables such as BMI and race/ethnicity may relate to need for uniqueness. No empirical data or study results are presented in this section.
